text: Figures for whole sweetened condensed milk as stated on the Russian Wikipedia page for the GOST standard.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The milk is warmed to 25–30 °C and cleared of impurities, then cooled for holding.
Cream or skim milk is added to bring the fat to the standard.
Stirred in near the end of boiling down, until the moisture is about 26 %.
Cooled before it is filled into cans.

sources.text: The steps and temperatures of making sweetened whole condensed milk, from the Russian article; it does not name the GOST step by step, and says nothing of lactose seeding.
